SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled. Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. 30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

Cheesy Garlic Potato Bread 🥔🧀 Prep Time: 1 hr 40 mins | Cook Time: 25 mins | Servings: 6-8 INGREDIENTS Soft Milk Dough 3 cups bread flour, plus extra for dusting 1 cup whole or 2% milk, warmed to 105°F-110°F 2 tsp instant yeast (1 standard packet) 1 tbsp granulated sugar (or honey) 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for greasing Creamy Gold Potato and Mozzarella Filling 1 lb Yukon Gold potatoes (about 2 medium-large), peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks 1 1/2 tbsp unsalted butter 1 1/2 tbsp mayonnaise (or sour cream/cream cheese) 1-2 tbsp milk, as needed 1/2 tsp kosher salt (plus salt for boiling water) 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper 1/4 tsp garlic powder 2 to 2 1/2 cups low-moisture mozzarella cheese, shredded Pan-Frying and Garlic Butter Finish 2-3 tbsp neutral oil or unsalted butter, divided 3 tbsp unsalted butter, melted 2-3 cloves garlic, finely grated or minced 2 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped 1/4 tsp kosher salt INSTRUCTIONS 1. Whisk warm milk, sugar, and instant yeast in a large bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy. Add bread flour, 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, and 2 tbsp olive oil, stirring until a shaggy dough forms. 2. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 6-8 minutes by hand (or 5-6 minutes in a stand mixer) until smooth and elastic. Place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover tightly, and let rise in a warm spot for 60-90 minutes until doubled. 3. Boil Yukon Gold potato chunks in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain thoroughly and return to the hot pot for 1 minute over low heat to evaporate excess moisture. 4. Mash potatoes smooth with 1 1/2 tbsp butter, mayonnaise, 1-2 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Cool completely to room temperature. 5. Punch down risen dough and divide into 8 equal balls. Roll each ball into a 5-inch circle, keeping the center slightly thicker than the edges. 6. Scoop 2 tbsp cooled mashed potatoes onto the center of a circle, flatten slightly, and top with a generous handful of shredded mozzarella, leaving a clean 1/2-inch border. 7. Gather dough edges over the filling, pinch the seam tightly shut, and place seam-side down on a lightly floured counter. Gently flatten with your palm and work into a 1/2-inch-thick disc. Repeat with remaining dough. 8. Heat 1 tbsp oil or butter in a large skillet over medium-low to medium heat. Cook 1-2 flatbreads for 3-4 minutes until golden-brown and blistered on the bottom. 9. Flip, press gently with a spatula, and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden on the second side. 10. Stir together 3 tbsp melted butter, grated garlic, chopped parsley, and 1/4 tsp salt. Hope y’all enjoy this one 🙌🏿🔥  Ingredients:  Green Beans- ~ 44oz Petite Golden Potatoes - 24oz bag Onion- 1 Red Bell Pepper- 1 Garlic- 4 cloves Bacon- 12oz Beef Smoked Sausage- 12oz Flour- 3 tbsp Chicken Stock (low sodium)- 7 cups Chicken Bouillon- 1 tbsp Salt- 1 tbsp White Pepper- 1 tbsp Onion Powder- 1 tbsp Garlic Powder- 1 tbsp Paprika-  2 tbsp Complete Seasoning or All Purpose Seasoning (salt free)- 2 tbsp Worcestershire Sauce- 1 tbsp Hot Sauce- 2 tbsp Cornstarch (for slurry)- 1 tbsp Water (for slurry) - 1 tbsp   Method:  Prep your ingredients before you start cooking to make the process smoother includes: chopping onions, garlic and peppers, chopping up the bacon and sausage, snipping and washing green beans, and cutting the golden potatoes in half.    Cook the bacon in a big pot on medium heat while constantly stirring allowing it to cook in its own fat. Take the lid off and add in the potatoes. Cover with a lid again for about 30 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender.    Add the cornstarch slurry in and allow the gravy to thicken up and you should be set! Cheesy Hash Brown Sausage Breakfast Casserole Ingredients 1. 8 frozen hash brown patties 2. 1 lb ground breakfast sausage 3. 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese 4. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 5. 6 large eggs 6. 1 cup whole milk 7. ½ cup heavy cream 8. ½ teaspoon garlic powder 9. ½ teaspoon onion powder 10. ½ teaspoon paprika 11. ½ teaspoon black pepper 12. ½ teaspoon salt 13. 2 tablespoons butter 14. ½ teaspoon dried parsley Recipe 1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Lightly grease a rectangular baking dish with butter or cooking spray. 3. Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the ground breakfast sausage. 4. Break the sausage into small pieces and cook until browned and fully cooked. 5. Drain excess grease and set the cooked sausage aside. 6. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and heavy cream until smooth. 7. Add garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and salt to the egg mixture. 8. Stir in 1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese and ½ cup of mozzarella cheese. 9. Spread the cooked sausage evenly across the bottom of the prepared baking dish. 10. Pour the egg and cheese mixture over the sausage, distributing it evenly. 11. Arrange the frozen hash brown patties in a single layer over the top, covering the entire casserole. 12. Sprinkle the remaining cheddar and mozzarella cheese around the patties and into the gaps. 13. Brush the tops of the hash brown patties lightly with melted butter for extra crispiness. 14. Sprinkle dried parsley over the top for added flavor. 15. Cover the baking dish loosely with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes. 16. Remove the foil and continue baking for another 20–25 minutes until the hash browns are golden and crispy. 17. Check that the egg mixture is completely set and reaches 160°F (71°C) in the center. 18. Allow the casserole to rest for 10 minutes before serving. 19. Cut into generous portions and serve warm with your favorite breakfast sides. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. INGREDIENTS: - 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, diced - 2 lbs baby potatoes, halved or quartered - 1 1/2 cups corn kernels (fresh, frozen, or drained canned) - 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup - 1/4 cup milk or chicken broth - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper - 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled - 2 tbsp chopped parsley INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Place the diced chicken and baby potatoes into the slow cooker. Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 2. Whisk the cream of chicken soup with the milk or broth, then pour it over the chicken and potatoes. 3. Sprinkle the corn kernels over the top. 4. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese and crispy bacon bits over everything. 5. Put the lid on and cook on low for 4-5 hours or on high for 2-3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender. 6. Shred the chicken with two forks, stir everything together, sprinkle with parsley, and serve hot straight from the slow cooker.
